scope: Argon3A and5A-C physical audit; no new observations; no SPHEREx fitting in this subtask.
known_before_test: All three fades and old CK04/Draine model comparisons known. This is retrospective application, not blind validation.
spot_test: Replace invented V=.35 anchor with actual g=.312. Monochromatic Planck(4500/3800K) pedagogical case plus passband CK04 spot predictions. Add actual CousinsR response and preserve distinction from Sloanr.
dust_test: Invert partial-screen depths at g=.48um andW1=3.4um for declared covering fractions; predict W2,R,I without fitting W2. Separately reproduce existing integrated Draine/atmosphere solutions. No alpha-to-grain-size unique inference.
atmosphere_grid: Existing CK04 finite LTE grid3500-6500K,metal-1,-.5,0,logg2,2.5,3; nominalhot4500 and4000,5000,5500 sensitivity. Existing per-nuisance best fits matchingg/W1 ±.02mag summarized; these are not confidence envelopes.
binary_inputs: Saved Gaia NSS period,K,e and errors; orbit remains candidate. Use published K10.72447, not K<=8 upperlimit. Mass/radius/inclination conditional cases; leading ellipsoidal amplitude validity flagged near Roche lobe.
scaleheight: H=kT/(mu*m_u*gSI) with gSI=10**loggCGS/100; hydrostatic/local temperature assumption. Nscaleheights5-10 is illustrative, not measured CO line-formation extent.
stellar_radius: Compare posterlogg1.7 conditionalmass radii, cautioned GaiaGSPphot radius9.2474, and clearly assumed V/BC/extinction combinations; no NLTE diagnosis from discrepancy.
sources: Primary Eggleton1983 Roche formula; Mazeh&Faigler2010 ellipsoidal coefficient0.15(15+u)(1+g)/(3-u).
limits: No model probabilities, physical upper limits, recovered orbital validation, dust detection or inferred stellar radius change.
